focus.jnote: The week’s risk-on tone carries over — but tonight’s NVDA print and three boarded names are what to verify, not a table to pound. After the Nasdaq Composite posted back-to-back record highs, futures on the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 hovered near the flat line as investors monitored U.S. diplomatic efforts with Iran and China. Oil turned lower after U.S. Energy Secretary Wright said over 17 million barrels of oil crossed the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, easing supply concerns and knocking the 10-year yield down toward ~4.79%. The VIX is near ~14.2–14.3, close to a year-to-date low. The scanner boarded three names — two Type C breakouts (WBD on the Paramount merger settlement, CPER on a copper high) and one Type A bearish post-earnings gap (KBH). On a calm-but-headline-driven tape with NVDA tonight, verify each hard before assuming there’s a trade.
focus.notdown: Media/M&A (WBD), copper (CPER) and chips/AI (NVDA, SMH) are the groups with a bid — WBD held a new 52-week high on Paramount merger-settlement progress and CPER is pressing a copper high, while chips firm into Nvidia’s print. Be honest: WBD’s move is a deal-closing-probability reprice and CPER is a same-day breakout still proving itself. These are the boarded names, but each carries a verify-first flag — watch, size small, confirm at 9:35.
focus.notup: Homebuilders (KBH and peers) are the group under pressure after KB Home beat on EPS but guided softer margins and a more cautious housing outlook. The scanner boarded KBH bearish, but the realised gap (−3.3%) was well under the ~8% implied move and reaction-day volume was thin — a weak confirmation. Selling a bear call into a light-volume gap on a risk-on tape carries squeeze risk; verify direction at 9:35.
focus.why: Why not GREEN? Two reasons. First, even though composite (43) and P(≥1% gap) (31%) both sit below their triggers, NVIDIA reports after the close tonight — a mega-cap chip catalyst that can gap the whole index — plus a headline-driven Iran/Hormuz story that could reverse on any re-escalation. Second, all three boarded names carry caveats: WBD (Type C · Grade A) is a 1-session breakout with only 1 S/R layer and a merger-headline catalyst; CPER (Type C · Grade A) is a same-day breakout with unknown OI and no verified earnings gate; KBH (Type A · Grade B+) gapped on very light volume, far under its implied move. That is a half-size, verify-first board, not a green light. Half size, A-grade only; confirm 4-VAL and liquidity at 9:35. Cash is a position today.
